swingContinuityEn: The buy score has steadily increased from 58 to 73 since October 21, while the sell score has decreased from 21 to 13, indicating a sustained bullish trend. Although the RSI saw a slight rebound from 37.45 on October 23 to 39.0 today, QQQ, SOXX, TSLA, and NVDA all experienced significant declines over the past five trading days (ranging from -2.86% to -6.79%) before showing minor recoveries (ranging from -0.20% to +1.43%). The extremely fearful market conditions, with VIX at 19.48 and Fear&Greed at 20, served as a backdrop for strengthening buying pressure.
